item.text: The malformed PURLs come from CycloneDX components using the raw package name as the PURL name with an empty namespace. I’ll add the requested parser in the SBOM package and use its three returned fields for both lockfile and dependency graph package PURLs.
The parser is now wired into both SBOM package paths. `go test ./reporter/sbom` is still running while Go compiles dependencies; I’m waiting for its result and then I’ll inspect the final diff.
